 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Maybe not the start the Golden State Warriors hoped for in their first game without Steph Curry , but probably the one that was most likely.
 The San Antonio Spurs raced out on a team record 18-0 run to begin Friday's NBA Cup Group C game, the Dubs' worst start in the play-by-play era. Golden State was held scoreless over the first six minutes until a Gui Santos layup finally got them on the board. Their previous worst start came on Jan. 28, 2005 against the Seattle SuperSonics.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Spurs' big run out the gates was sparked by Stephon Castle, who leads the game with 13 points, two assists and a rebound and is a perfect 3-of-3 from long range. Victor Wembanyama has four points, three rebounds and three assists as San Antonio has built a 38-15 lead through the first quarter.
 LJ Cryer was able to muster some offense for Golden State with two 3s to get a quick six points off the bench. The Spurs are looking for their 11th straight win.
